vb_textbox.text: I like the colours and design of the game/ the characters/background. But I didnt understand if there was a pattern to be able to get more mushrooms, such as choosing a specific type of gnome or if it was random. If it was random it seemed a bit pointless to play for a long time, if there was a reward or aim it might make more sense or a story as to why we need to collect so many mushrooms
